column1: # Stage S10 H3a, third Mission Creator crate: the editor's browser session (the IndexedDB draft
# writer and its status surface, the server hydrate and its conflict prompt, the cross-tab writer
# role, the warm-session marker, the title preference, the payload-size readout and the browser
# transport behind Save, Export and the clipboard commands) becomes
# crates/frontend/workspaces/mission_creator_session. The folder becomes the crate's `src`, its
# module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README. The prefix is one `crate::` row
# scoped to the moved folder and one `mission_creator_session::` row scoped to the app's source.
